nodes.label: “贵人多忘事”，这里的“贵人”是做大官的人或者做大生意的人。 ("Guìrén duō wàng shì", zhèlǐ de "guìrén" shì zuò dà guān de rén huòzhě zuò dà shēngyi de rén.) - In "贵人多忘事", "贵人" means a person who holds high office or does big business.
nodes.norm_label: “贵人多忘事”,这里的“贵人”是做大官的人或者做大生意的人。 ("guiren duo wang shi", zheli de "guiren" shi zuo da guan de ren huozhe zuo da shengyi de ren.) - in "贵人多忘事", "贵人" means a person who holds high office or does big business.

nodes.label: 这句话的意思是做大官或者做大生意的人因为事情太多，所以常常会忘记做一些小事。 (Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì zuò dà guān huòzhě zuò dà shēngyi de rén yīnwèi shìqing tài duō, suǒyǐ chángcháng huì wàngjì zuò yìxiē xiǎo shì.) - The saying means that people in high office or in big business often forget trivial things because they have too much to do.
nodes.norm_label: 这句话的意思是做大官或者做大生意的人因为事情太多,所以常常会忘记做一些小事。 (zhe ju hua de yisi shi zuo da guan huozhe zuo da shengyi de ren yinwei shiqing tai duo, suoyi changchang hui wangji zuo yixie xiao shi.) - the saying means that people in high office or in big business often forget trivial things because they have too much to do.

nodes.label: 现在一般用在对话中表示客气，说明一个人工作太忙，事情太多，忘记一些小事是可以理解的，有时候也有一种讽刺的意味。 (Xiànzài yìbān yòng zài duìhuà zhōng biǎoshì kèqi, shuōmíng yí ge rén gōngzuò tài máng, shìqing tài duō, wàngjì yìxiē xiǎo shì shì kěyǐ lǐjiě de, yǒu shíhou yě yǒu yì zhǒng fěngcì de yìwèi.) - Now it is generally used in conversation to be polite, showing that someone is so busy that forgetting small things is understandable; sometimes it also carries an ironic tone.
nodes.norm_label: 现在一般用在对话中表示客气,说明一个人工作太忙,事情太多,忘记一些小事是可以理解的,有时候也有一种讽刺的意味。 (xianzai yiban yong zai duihua zhong biaoshi keqi, shuoming yi ge ren gongzuo tai mang, shiqing tai duo, wangji yixie xiao shi shi keyi lijie de, you shihou ye you yi zhong fengci de yiwei.) - now it is generally used in conversation to be polite, showing that someone is so busy that forgetting small things is understandable; sometimes it also carries an ironic tone.

nodes.label: 在中国，常用的通信工具有电话机和手机两种。 (Zài Zhōngguó, chángyòng de tōngxìn gōngjù yǒu diànhuàjī hé shǒujī liǎng zhǒng.) - In China, there are two kinds of common communication tools—telephones and cell phones.
nodes.community_name: Phone Numbers; Communication Tools Culture Note
nodes.norm_label: 在中国,常用的通信工具有电话机和手机两种。 (zai zhongguo, changyong de tongxin gongju you dianhuaji he shouji liang zhong.) - in china, there are two kinds of common communication tools—telephones and cell phones.

nodes.label: 电话机号码一般为7-8位，比如2027816、82304156，不同地区的电话机号码位数不同。 (Diànhuàjī hàomǎ yìbān wéi 7-8 wèi, bǐrú 2027816, 82304156, bùtóng dìqū de diànhuàjī hàomǎ wèishù bùtóng.) - A telephone number usually has 7-8 digits, for example, 2027816, 82304156. Telephone numbers in different regions have different numbers of digits.
nodes.community_name: Phone Numbers; Communication Tools Culture Note
nodes.norm_label: 电话机号码一般为7-8位,比如2027816、82304156,不同地区的电话机号码位数不同。 (dianhuaji haoma yiban wei 7-8 wei, biru 2027816, 82304156, butong diqu de dianhuaji haoma weishu butong.) - a telephone number usually has 7-8 digits, for example, 2027816, 82304156. telephone numbers in different regions have different numbers of digits.

nodes.label: 手机号码的位数没有地区的差别，都是11位，比如13576983311。 (Shǒujī hàomǎ de wèishù méiyǒu dìqū de chābié, dōu shì 11 wèi, bǐrú 13576983311.) - Cell phone numbers, however, always have 11 digits regardless of region, as in 13576983311.
nodes.community_name: Phone Numbers; Communication Tools Culture Note
nodes.norm_label: 手机号码的位数没有地区的差别,都是11位,比如13576983311。 (shouji haoma de weishu meiyou diqu de chabie, dou shi 11 wei, biru 13576983311.) - cell phone numbers, however, always have 11 digits regardless of region, as in 13576983311.

nodes.label: 由于手机号码位数较多，读时一般切分为“3-4-4”的停顿模式，比如139-0107-8866。 (Yóuyú shǒujī hàomǎ wèishù jiào duō, dú shí yìbān qiēfēn wéi “3-4-4” de tíngdùn móshì, bǐrú 139-0107-8866.) - Since a cell phone number has many digits, it is read with pauses following the pattern "3-4-4", such as 139-0107-8866.
nodes.community_name: Phone Numbers; Communication Tools Culture Note
nodes.norm_label: 由于手机号码位数较多,读时一般切分为“3-4-4”的停顿模式,比如139-0107-8866。 (youyu shouji haoma weishu jiao duo, du shi yiban qiefen wei “3-4-4” de tingdun moshi, biru 139-0107-8866.) - since a cell phone number has many digits, it is read with pauses following the pattern "3-4-4", such as 139-0107-8866.

nodes.label: 其中号码中的“1”要读成“yāo”。 (Qízhōng hàomǎ zhōng de “1” yào dúchéng “yāo”.) - "1" is read as "yāo" in a phone number.

nodes.label: “一是一，二是二”，这句话的意思是保留事物的真实面貌，不做任何改变，常常用来比喻一个人说话做事很诚实，不骗别人。 (“Yī shì yī, èr shì èr”, zhè jù huà de yìsi shì bǎoliú shìwù de zhēnshí miànmào, bú zuò rènhé gǎibiàn, chángcháng yònglái bǐyù yí ge rén shuō huà zuò shì hěn chéngshí, bú piàn biérén.) - The saying “一是一，二是二” means to keep the true look of something without any alteration; it is often used metaphorically to describe someone who is honest in word and deed and doesn't lie.

nodes.label: 内容的多样性和丰富性，一般来说，一个主题确定后，通过接触和这个主题相关的多个方面的学习内容，加速学生对新内容的内化和理解，进而深入探究，培养学生的创造能力。"教程"为了联系学生的实际，开阔学生的视野，从四级分册开始以主题引领，每个主题下又分为若干小主题，主题之间相互联系形成有机的知识网络，使之牢固地镶嵌在学生的记忆深处，不易遗忘。 (Nèiróng de duōyàngxìng hé fēngfùxìng, yībān lái shuō, yī gè zhǔtí quèdìng hòu, tōngguò jiēchù hé zhège zhǔtí xiāngguān de duō gè fāngmiàn de xuéxí nèiróng, jiāsù xuéshēng duì xīn nèiróng de nèihuà hé lǐjiě, jìn'ér shēnrù tànjiū, péiyǎng xuéshēng de chuàngzào nénglì. "Jiàochéng" wèile liánxì xuéshēng de shíjì, kāikuò xuéshēng de shìyě, cóng sì jí fēncè kāishǐ yǐ zhǔtí yǐnlǐng, měi gè zhǔtí xià yòu fēnwéi ruògān xiǎo zhǔtí, zhǔtí zhījiān xiānghù liánxì xíngchéng yǒujī de zhīshì wǎngluò, shǐ zhī láogù de xiāngqiàn zài xuéshēng de jìyì shēnchù, bùyì yíwàng.) - Once a topic is fixed, exposure to multiple aspects of learning content related to it accelerates students' internalization and understanding of new content, leads to deeper exploration, and cultivates creative ability; starting from the fourth-level volumes the Course is led by themes, each divided into sub-themes, interconnected into an organic network of knowledge firmly embedded in students' memory.
nodes.norm_label: 内容的多样性和丰富性,一般来说,一个主题确定后,通过接触和这个主题相关的多个方面的学习内容,加速学生对新内容的内化和理解,进而深入探究,培养学生的创造能力。"教程"为了联系学生的实际,开阔学生的视野,从四级分册开始以主题引领,每个主题下又分为若干小主题,主题之间相互联系形成有机的知识网络,使之牢固地镶嵌在学生的记忆深处,不易遗忘。 (neirong de duoyangxing he fengfuxing, yiban lai shuo, yi ge zhuti queding hou, tongguo jiechu he zhege zhuti xiangguan de duo ge fangmian de xuexi neirong, jiasu xuesheng dui xin neirong de neihua he lijie, jin'er shenru tanjiu, peiyang xuesheng de chuangzao nengli. "jiaocheng" weile lianxi xuesheng de shiji, kaikuo xuesheng de shiye, cong si ji fence kaishi yi zhuti yinling, mei ge zhuti xia you fenwei ruogan xiao zhuti, zhuti zhijian xianghu lianxi xingcheng youji de zhishi wangluo, shi zhi laogu de xiangqian zai xuesheng de jiyi shenchu, buyi yiwang.) - once a topic is fixed, exposure to multiple aspects of learning content related to it accelerates students' internalization and understanding of new content, leads to deeper exploration, and cultivates creative ability; starting from the fourth-level volumes the course is led by themes, each divided into sub-themes, interconnected into an organic network of knowledge firmly embedded in students' memory.

nodes.label: 汉语水平考试（HSK）共分六个等级，"教程"编教人员仔细研读了"大纲"和出题指南，并对大量真题进行了统计、分析。根据真题统计结果归纳出每册的重点、难点、语言点、话题、功能、场景等，在遵循HSK大纲词汇要求的前提下，系统设计了各级别的范围、课时等，具体安排如下： (Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì (HSK) gòng fēn liù gè děngjí, "jiàochéng" biānjiào rényuán zǐxì yándúle "dàgāng" hé chūtí zhǐnán, bìng duì dàliàng zhēntí jìnxíngle tǒngjì, fēnxī. Gēnjù zhēntí tǒngjì jiéguǒ guīnà chū měi cè de zhòngdiǎn, nándiǎn, yǔyándiǎn, huàtí, gōngnéng, chǎngjǐng děng, zài zūnxún HSK dàgāng cíhuì yāoqiú de qiántí xià, xìtǒng shèjìle gè jíbié de fànwéi, kèshí děng, jùtǐ ānpái rúxià:) - The HSK is divided into six levels; the editors studied the Syllabus and question-writing guidelines and statistically analysed many real exam questions, summarising each volume's key points, difficulties, language points, topics, functions and scenarios, and systematically designed the scope and class hours of each level within the HSK Syllabus vocabulary requirements, as follows:

nodes.label: 这种设计遵循汉语国际教育的理念，注重教材的普适性、应用性和实用性，海内外教学机构可根据学时建议来设计每册书完成的年限。比如，一级的《教程1》规定用34学时完成，如果国内周课时是8课时的话，大概一个月左右就能学完；在海外如果一周是4课时的话，就需要两个月的时间能学完。以此类推。一般来说，学完《教程1》就能通过一级考试，同样学完《教程2》就能通过二级考试，等等。 (Zhè zhǒng shèjì zūnxún Hànyǔ guójì jiàoyù de lǐniàn, zhùzhòng jiàocái de pǔshìxìng, yìngyòngxìng hé shíyòngxìng, hǎinèiwài jiàoxué jīgòu kě gēnjù xuéshí jiànyì lái shèjì měi cè shū wánchéng de niánxiàn. Bǐrú, yī jí de "Jiàochéng 1" guīdìng yòng 34 xuéshí wánchéng, rúguǒ guónèi zhōu kèshí shì 8 kèshí dehuà, dàgài yī gè yuè zuǒyòu jiù néng xuéwán; zài hǎiwài rúguǒ yī zhōu shì 4 kèshí dehuà, jiù xūyào liǎng gè yuè de shíjiān néng xuéwán. Yǐ cǐ lèituī. Yībān lái shuō, xuéwán "Jiàochéng 1" jiù néng tōngguò yī jí kǎoshì, tóngyàng xuéwán "Jiàochéng 2" jiù néng tōngguò èr jí kǎoshì, děngděng.) - The design follows the philosophy of international Chinese education; institutions can set the completion time per volume from the recommended class hours. For example, Course 1 is designed for 34 class hours: about one month at 8 hours per week domestically, two months at 4 hours per week abroad. Generally, finishing Course 1 lets one pass the Level 1 exam, finishing Course 2 the Level 2 exam, and so on.
nodes.norm_label: 这种设计遵循汉语国际教育的理念,注重教材的普适性、应用性和实用性,海内外教学机构可根据学时建议来设计每册书完成的年限。比如,一级的《教程1》规定用34学时完成,如果国内周课时是8课时的话,大概一个月左右就能学完;在海外如果一周是4课时的话,就需要两个月的时间能学完。以此类推。一般来说,学完《教程1》就能通过一级考试,同样学完《教程2》就能通过二级考试,等等。 (zhe zhong sheji zunxun hanyu guoji jiaoyu de linian, zhuzhong jiaocai de pushixing, yingyongxing he shiyongxing, haineiwai jiaoxue jigou ke genju xueshi jianyi lai sheji mei ce shu wancheng de nianxian. biru, yi ji de "jiaocheng 1" guiding yong 34 xueshi wancheng, ruguo guonei zhou keshi shi 8 keshi dehua, dagai yi ge yue zuoyou jiu neng xuewan; zai haiwai ruguo yi zhou shi 4 keshi dehua, jiu xuyao liang ge yue de shijian neng xuewan. yi ci leitui. yiban lai shuo, xuewan "jiaocheng 1" jiu neng tongguo yi ji kaoshi, tongyang xuewan "jiaocheng 2" jiu neng tongguo er ji kaoshi, dengdeng.) - the design follows the philosophy of international chinese education; institutions can set the completion time per volume from the recommended class hours. for example, course 1 is designed for 34 class hours: about one month at 8 hours per week domestically, two months at 4 hours per week abroad. generally, finishing course 1 lets one pass the level 1 exam, finishing course 2 the level 2 exam, and so on.

nodes.label: 为了使学习者适应HSK的考试题型，教材的各级练习册设计的练习题型均与HSK考试题型吻合，从练习的顺序到练习的结构等都与考题试卷保持一致，练习的内容以本课的内容为主，目的是学习者学完教材就能适应HSK考试，不需额外熟悉考试形式。 (Wèile shǐ xuéxízhě shìyìng HSK de kǎoshì tíxíng, jiàocái de gè jí liànxí cè shèjì de liànxí tíxíng jūn yǔ HSK kǎoshì tíxíng wěnhé, cóng liànxí de shùnxù dào liànxí de jiégòu děng dōu yǔ kǎotí shìjuàn bǎochí yīzhì, liànxí de nèiróng yǐ běn kè de nèiróng wéi zhǔ, mùdì shì xuéxízhě xuéwán jiàocái jiù néng shìyìng HSK kǎoshì, bù xū éwài shúxī kǎoshì xíngshì.) - So that learners adapt to the HSK question types, the workbook exercises at every level match the HSK question types in order and structure, with content based mainly on the lesson, so learners can adapt to the HSK exam after finishing the textbook without extra familiarization with the exam format.
nodes.norm_label: 为了使学习者适应hsk的考试题型,教材的各级练习册设计的练习题型均与hsk考试题型吻合,从练习的顺序到练习的结构等都与考题试卷保持一致,练习的内容以本课的内容为主,目的是学习者学完教材就能适应hsk考试,不需额外熟悉考试形式。 (weile shi xuexizhe shiying hsk de kaoshi tixing, jiaocai de ge ji lianxi ce sheji de lianxi tixing jun yu hsk kaoshi tixing wenhe, cong lianxi de shunxu dao lianxi de jiegou deng dou yu kaoti shijuan baochi yizhi, lianxi de neirong yi ben ke de neirong wei zhu, mudi shi xuexizhe xuewan jiaocai jiu neng shiying hsk kaoshi, bu xu ewai shuxi kaoshi xingshi.) - so that learners adapt to the hsk question types, the workbook exercises at every level match the hsk question types in order and structure, with content based mainly on the lesson, so learners can adapt to the hsk exam after finishing the textbook without extra familiarization with the exam format.

nodes.label: 在HSK考试中，口试独立于笔试之外，为了培养学生的口语表达能力，在教程中，每一课都提供交际练习，包括双人活动和小组活动等，为学习者参加口试提供保障。 (Zài HSK kǎoshì zhōng, kǒushì dúlì yú bǐshì zhī wài, wèile péiyǎng xuéshēng de kǒuyǔ biǎodá nénglì, zài jiàochéng zhōng, měi yī kè dōu tígōng jiāojì liànxí, bāokuò shuāngrén huódòng hé xiǎozǔ huódòng děng, wèi xuéxízhě cānjiā kǒushì tígōng bǎozhàng.) - In the HSK exam the oral test is independent of the written test; to cultivate oral expression, every lesson of the course provides communicative exercises, including pair and group activities, to prepare learners for the oral test.
nodes.norm_label: 在hsk考试中,口试独立于笔试之外,为了培养学生的口语表达能力,在教程中,每一课都提供交际练习,包括双人活动和小组活动等,为学习者参加口试提供保障。 (zai hsk kaoshi zhong, koushi duli yu bishi zhi wai, weile peiyang xuesheng de kouyu biaoda nengli, zai jiaocheng zhong, mei yi ke dou tigong jiaoji lianxi, baokuo shuangren huodong he xiaozu huodong deng, wei xuexizhe canjia koushi tigong baozhang.) - in the hsk exam the oral test is independent of the written test; to cultivate oral expression, every lesson of the course provides communicative exercises, including pair and group activities, to prepare learners for the oral test.

nodes.label: 这句话告诉我们，开始做事情的时候遇到困难是正常的，不要因此而放弃，要坚持下去，以后会越做越容易，越来越好。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen, kāishǐ zuò shìqing de shíhou yùdào kùnnan shì zhèngcháng de, bú yào yīncǐ ér fàngqì, yào jiānchí xiàqu, yǐhòu huì yuè zuò yuè róngyì, yuè lái yuè hǎo.) - This saying tells us that meeting difficulties at the start is normal; do not give up because of them but persevere, and it will get easier and better.
nodes.norm_label: 这句话告诉我们,开始做事情的时候遇到困难是正常的,不要因此而放弃,要坚持下去,以后会越做越容易,越来越好。 (zhe ju hua gaosu women, kaishi zuo shiqing de shihou yudao kunnan shi zhengchang de, bu yao yinci er fangqi, yao jianchi xiaqu, yihou hui yue zuo yue rongyi, yue lai yue hao.) - this saying tells us that meeting difficulties at the start is normal; do not give up because of them but persevere, and it will get easier and better.

nodes.label: 一步走错步步错。 (Yí bù zǒucuò bùbù cuò.) - One wrong move makes all moves wrong.

nodes.label: "一步走错步步错"的意思是，下棋的时候，如果有一步走错了，那么以后的每一步都是错的。 ("Yí bù zǒucuò bùbù cuò" de yìsi shì, xià qí de shíhou, rúguǒ yǒu yí bù zǒucuò le, nàme yǐhòu de měi yí bù dōu shì cuò de.) - It means that in a chess game, if one move is wrong, then every later move will be wrong too.
nodes.norm_label: "一步走错步步错"的意思是,下棋的时候,如果有一步走错了,那么以后的每一步都是错的。 ("yi bu zoucuo bubu cuo" de yisi shi, xia qi de shihou, ruguo you yi bu zoucuo le, name yihou de mei yi bu dou shi cuo de.) - it means that in a chess game, if one move is wrong, then every later move will be wrong too.

nodes.label: 这句话用来比喻如果我们开始时做了一个错误的决定，那么以后的每一次决定都会是错的。 (Zhè jù huà yònglái bǐyù rúguǒ wǒmen kāishǐ shí zuòle yí ge cuòwù de juédìng, nàme yǐhòu de měi yí cì juédìng dōu huì shì cuò de.) - Metaphorically, it means that if we make a wrong decision at the start, every decision after it will be wrong.
nodes.norm_label: 这句话用来比喻如果我们开始时做了一个错误的决定,那么以后的每一次决定都会是错的。 (zhe ju hua yonglai biyu ruguo women kaishi shi zuole yi ge cuowu de jueding, name yihou de mei yi ci jueding dou hui shi cuo de.) - metaphorically, it means that if we make a wrong decision at the start, every decision after it will be wrong.

nodes.label: 这句话告诉我们，做事情的时候每一步都要谨慎，避免出现错误，尤其是开始的时候。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen, zuò shìqing de shíhou měi yí bù dōu yào jǐnshèn, bìmiǎn chūxiàn cuòwù, yóuqí shì kāishǐ de shíhou.) - This saying tells us to be prudent at every step, to avoid mistakes, especially at the beginning.
nodes.norm_label: 这句话告诉我们,做事情的时候每一步都要谨慎,避免出现错误,尤其是开始的时候。 (zhe ju hua gaosu women, zuo shiqing de shihou mei yi bu dou yao jinshen, bimian chuxian cuowu, youqi shi kaishi de shihou.) - this saying tells us to be prudent at every step, to avoid mistakes, especially at the beginning.

nodes.label: 站得高，看得远。 (Zhàn de gāo, kàn de yuǎn.) - The higher you stand, the farther you'll see.

nodes.label: "站得高，看得远"的意思是，站在高的地方，就能看到更远的地方。 ("Zhàn de gāo, kàn de yuǎn" de yìsi shì, zhàn zài gāo de dìfang, jiù néng kàndào gèng yuǎn de dìfang.) - It means that standing in a high place, you can see farther places.

nodes.label: 这句话也用来比喻不能只从一个方面看问题，多考虑几个方面，才能更加全面。 (Zhè jù huà yě yònglái bǐyù bù néng zhǐ cóng yí ge fāngmiàn kàn wèntí, duō kǎolǜ jǐ ge fāngmiàn, cáinéng gèngjiā quánmiàn.) - It is also used metaphorically: do not view a problem from one aspect only; consider several aspects to be more comprehensive.

nodes.label: 这句话的意思是，平时做事的方法习惯了，慢慢就变成自然的事了，很难再改变了。 (Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì, píngshí zuò shì de fāngfǎ xíguàn le, mànmàn jiù biànchéng zìrán de shì le, hěn nán zài gǎibiàn le.) - The saying means that once the way you usually do something becomes a habit, it gradually becomes natural and hard to change.
nodes.community_name: HSK 3 习惯 and 成 Saying
nodes.norm_label: 这句话的意思是,平时做事的方法习惯了,慢慢就变成自然的事了,很难再改变了。 (zhe ju hua de yisi shi, pingshi zuo shi de fangfa xiguan le, manman jiu biancheng ziran de shi le, hen nan zai gaibian le.) - the saying means that once the way you usually do something becomes a habit, it gradually becomes natural and hard to change.

nodes.label: 这句话告诉我们要养成好的习惯，不要觉得不好的事情只做一次没关系，如果不注意，慢慢就会变成很自然的事，到时候就不容易发现错误，也不容易改变了。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen yào yǎngchéng hǎo de xíguàn, bú yào juéde bù hǎo de shìqing zhǐ zuò yí cì méi guānxi, rúguǒ bú zhùyì, mànmàn jiù huì biànchéng hěn zìrán de shì, dào shíhou jiù bù róngyì fāxiàn cuòwù, yě bù róngyì gǎibiàn le.) - It tells us to form good habits and not to think a bad thing done just once does not matter; if we are not careful it gradually becomes natural, and then the mistake is hard to notice or change.
nodes.community_name: HSK 3 习惯 and 成 Saying
nodes.norm_label: 这句话告诉我们要养成好的习惯,不要觉得不好的事情只做一次没关系,如果不注意,慢慢就会变成很自然的事,到时候就不容易发现错误,也不容易改变了。 (zhe ju hua gaosu women yao yangcheng hao de xiguan, bu yao juede bu hao de shiqing zhi zuo yi ci mei guanxi, ruguo bu zhuyi, manman jiu hui biancheng hen ziran de shi, dao shihou jiu bu rongyi faxian cuowu, ye bu rongyi gaibian le.) - it tells us to form good habits and not to think a bad thing done just once does not matter; if we are not careful it gradually becomes natural, and then the mistake is hard to notice or change.

nodes.label: “钱不是万能的”，这句话的意思是钱虽然很重要，但是钱不能解决所有的问题。 (“Qián bú shì wànnéng de”, zhè jù huà de yìsi shì qián suīrán hěn zhòngyào, dànshì qián bù néng jiějué suǒyǒu de wèntí.) - “钱不是万能的” means that although money is very important, it cannot solve all problems.

nodes.label: 这句话告诉我们对待金钱要有正确的认识，虽然生活中处处需要钱，但是有钱也不一定能办成所有的事情。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen duìdài jīnqián yào yǒu zhèngquè de rènshi, suīrán shēnghuó zhōng chùchù xūyào qián, dànshì yǒu qián yě bù yídìng néng bàn chéng suǒyǒu de shìqing.) - This saying tells us to have a correct attitude towards money: although we need money everywhere in life, having money does not necessarily mean everything can be accomplished.

nodes.label: 春节是中国人的“新年”，是中国最重要的传统节日。 (Chūnjié shì Zhōngguórén de “xīnnián”, shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de chuántǒng jiérì.) - Spring Festival, or the Chinese New Year, is the most important traditional festival in China.
